metadata.Name: LAMBADA
metadata.Description: A dataset for evaluating computational models on text understanding by means of a word prediction task
metadata.Paper Title: The LAMBADA dataset: Word prediction requiring a broad discourse context
metadata.Venue Name: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
Affiliations: CIMeC - Center for Mind/Brain Sciences, University of Trento
Institute for Logic, Language & Computation, University of Amsterdam
metadata.Abstract: We introduce LAMBADA, a dataset to evaluate the capabilities of computational models for text understanding by means of a word prediction task. LAMBADA is a collection of narrative passages sharing the characteristic that human subjects are able to guess their last word if they are exposed to the whole passage, but not if they only see the last sentence preceding the target word. To succeed on LAMBADA, computational models cannot simply rely on local context, but must be able to keep track of information in the broader discourse.
